questions.q: Which actor plays the title hero Jaison in Minnal Murali?
questions.why: Tovino Thomas plays Jaison, and also a second role in the same film.
Basil Joseph directed the 2021 Malayalam superhero film.

questions.q: Which streaming service released Minnal Murali worldwide in December 2021?
questions.why: After plans for a theatrical release were dropped, Netflix released it on 24 December 2021.

questions.q: What is the name of the village where Jaison lives?
questions.why: The story is set in the fictional village of Kurukkanmoola in Kerala.

questions.q: What is Jaison's job before the lightning strike?
questions.why: Jaison works as a tailor in Varkey's shop.

questions.q: On which evening does lightning strike Jaison and Shibu?
questions.why: The lightning strikes on Christmas Eve, giving both men their powers.

questions.q: Besides Jaison, which character does the lead actor play in Minnal Murali?
questions.why: Tovino has a dual role: Jaison and Martin Rangakala, Jaison's biological father.

questions.q: Who composed the film score of Minnal Murali?
questions.why: Sushin Shyam scored the film and shared songs with Shaan Rahman.

questions.q: Who produced Minnal Murali under Weekend Blockbusters?
questions.why: Sophia Paul produced the film through her banner Weekend Blockbusters.

questions.q: Which character is Jaison's karate-instructor girlfriend?
questions.why: 'Bruce Lee' Biji, played by Femina George, is a travel agent and karate instructor.
